summary: Goal-assessor citations are now parsed as `path:line`/`path:start-end` and validated for repo-relative containment (symlink-resolved), regular-file-ness and line range, with `readVerdicts` rejecting such a reply the way any unusable reply is rejected; tests and lint are green.
blockers: none — the one deviation from the brief is that the requested `//nolint:gosec // G304` directive was omitted because gosec does not fire there and nolintlint fails the build on the unused directive; the reasoning is kept as a prose comment.
